name: Journal rules
description: Lists journal rules with their scope, the recipient they journal, the journal address that receives reports and whether each is enabled.

parameters.name: OnlyEnabled
parameters.label: Only enabled rules
parameters.help: Leave out rules Exchange reports as disabled. A rule whose state is unknown is kept.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read journal rules, such as View-Only Organization Management or Compliance Management.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
No journal rules is a valid result: the run returns no rows and no warning.
A rule whose recipient is returned empty journals every recipient and is shown as AllRecipients; a recipient not returned at all is Unknown.
The journal address is shown as returned; whether that mailbox exists or accepts journal reports is not checked.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
